newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni confirms report on power plant investment.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni confirms report on power plant investment.

text.p: Marubeni Corp on Wednesday confirmed a newspaper report that it and leading U.S. electricity wholesaler Sithe Energies Inc plan to jointly invest $2 billion to build about 50 power plants, mainly in Asia.
Marubeni will invest $800 million before the end of 2000, while Sithe Energies plans to invest $1.2 billion, a Marubeni spokesman said.
In their first project, the two companies plan to invest $175 million to build a 100,000-kilowatt capacity power plant in Hebei Province in China, the official said.
The companies have set up a joint venture with a local firm in China for the project and construction of the power plant is expected to be completed in 1998.

Marubeni and Sithe Energies plan to bid for about 30 power plant projects in other Asian countries, including Indonesia and Thailand, the spokesman said, adding they also plan to build plants in North, Central and South America.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday that Marubeni and Sithe Energies had agreed on a joint project to invest $2 billion to build power plants in Asia and North and South America.
